note: Translation of geologic map unit codes to the game's landform families, for points clicked on the Moon or Mars. Reviewed by nobody: written from the unit names during the quest run of 2026-11-15, not checked by a geologist. Only units whose name clearly supports a family are mapped; the rest are null, which makes the ranking terrain-only. A mapped family is scored at 75% (unreviewed). A geologic crater unit includes the crater's ejecta and floor, not only its bowl.

Mars.citation: Tanaka, K.L., and others, 2014, Geologic map of Mars: U.S. Geological Survey Scientific Investigations Map 3292, scale 1:20,000,000.
